correctness.rationale: Full proof reconstructed: zero difference sites are independent; n-k even supplies exactly two word lifts; flips correspond bijectively to token slides; gap surplus of n-2k>0 connects projected token sets; explicit n-slide closed loop traverses every cycle edge once and toggles each original bit, joining complementary lifts. Endpoint levels are immobile. Positive composition counts and the clockwise-slide enumeration yield the exact sector size/edge formulas. Direct breadth-first search of actual Hamming-one graphs, with independent gap counts, passes through n=18. Mathematical proof is for every n>=3 and does not infer infinity from enumeration.
